_comment: Community reports from riders and locals. Newest wins. These OVERRIDE the defaults in build_supply.py and raise a data point's confidence to 'reported'. Add entries via the GitHub issue forms in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/, then run: python3 merge_reports.py

_schema.mile: route mile the entry is keyed to (must match build_supply.py)
_schema.date: YYYY-MM-DD the reporter was actually there
_schema.status: water only: tap | developed | perennial | seasonal | intermittent | none
_schema.name: business only: enough of the name to match
